words.ex: My father cooks breakfast every morning.
words.ex_cn: 我父亲每天早上做早餐。
words.en: A male parent of a child; a man who has begotten a child.

words.tr: n. 课；班级；等级；阶级；类别；
words.ex: I have math class at 9 a.m.
words.en: A class is a group of pupils or students who are taught together.

words.tr:

words.ex_cn: 这是通过考试的最后机会。
words.en: Coming after all others in time or order; final.

words.ex: He drives a red car to work.
words.en: A car is a motor vehicle with four wheels, usually propelled by an internal combustion engine.

words.ex: I used my card to pay for the groceries.
words.ex_cn: 我用我的银行卡支付了杂货费用。
words.en: A card is a piece of stiff paper or thin cardboard on which something is written or printed, or a small rectangular piece of plastic containing personal data in a machine-readable form.

words.tr:
n. 农场；农庄；
v. 耕种；
words.ex: He works on a small farm with cows and chickens.
words.ex_cn: 他在一个养牛和鸡的小农场工作。
words.en: A farm is an area of land, together with the buildings on it, that is used for growing crops or raising animals.

words.tr:
n. 手臂；
v. 武装；
words.ex: He raised his arm to wave hello.
words.en: An arm is one of the two long parts of your body that are attached to your shoulders and that have your hands at the end.

words.ex: My aunt bought me a birthday gift.
words.ex_cn: 我姨给我买了一份生日礼物。
words.en: The sister of your father or mother, or the wife of your uncle.

words.tr:
v. 笑；发笑；
n. 笑；笑声；
words.ex: He laugh when he saw the funny cat.
words.ex_cn: 他看到那只滑稽的猫时笑了。
words.en: To laugh means to make the spontaneous sounds and movements of the face and body that are the instinctive expressions of lively amusement and sometimes also of derision.

words.tr:
n. 一半；
adj. 一半的；
adv. 一半地；
words.ex: He ate half of the apple.
words.en: One of two equal parts into which something is or can be divided.

words.tr:
adj. 平静的；镇静的；
v. （使）平静；（使）镇定；
n. 平静；
words.ex: The lake was calm in the morning.
words.en: If someone is calm, they are not excited, anxious, or upset, but are rational and composed.

words.ex: The palm tree grows near the beach.
words.en: The inner surface of the hand that extends from the wrist to the base of the fingers; also refers to the tropical tree with large divided leaves.

words.ex: He felt a pain in his heart.
words.en: The heart is the organ in your chest that pumps the blood around your body. People also use heart to refer to the area of their chest that is closest to their heart.

words.tr: n. 壁炉地面；炉床；炉边
words.ex: She sat by the hearth to keep warm.
words.en: The floor of a fireplace, often extending into a room and paved with brick, stone, or cement, used as a place to build fires or for sitting in front of a fire.

words.ex: I like apples, and I also like oranges.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢苹果，我也喜欢橙子。
words.en: You use also to give more information about something or to add another relevant fact.

words.ex: He almost finished his homework.
words.en: You use almost to indicate that something is not completely the case but is nearly the case.

words.ex: The boy kicked the ball into the net.
words.en: A ball is a round object that is used in games such as soccer, baseball, and basketball. It can also refer to a formal dance.

words.ex: He paints the wall blue.
words.en: A wall is a vertical structure, often made of stone or brick, that divides or encloses an area of land.

words.ex: He has a small dog.
words.en: If something is small, it is not large in size or amount.

words.ex: He is a tall man.
words.en: If something is tall, it is higher than usual or than other things of its type.

words.ex: He closed the door quietly.
words.en: A door is a piece of wood, glass, or metal, which is moved to open and close the entrance to a building, room, cupboard, or vehicle.

words.ex: My room is on the third floor.
words.en: The floor is the surface of a room on which you stand.

words.ex: He has short hair.
words.en: If something is short, it measures a small distance from one end to the other.

words.ex: He has forty books on his shelf.
words.ex_cn: 他的书架上有四十本书。
words.en: The number 40.

words.ex: The boy rides a horse every morning.
words.ex_cn: 这个男孩每天早上骑马。
words.en: A horse is a large animal which people can ride. Some horses are used for pulling ploughs and carts.

words.tr:
prep. 为；因为；给；
conj. 因为；由于；
words.ex: I bought this gift for my mother.
words.ex_cn: 我为我妈妈买了这份礼物。
words.en: If something is for a particular person, group, or purpose, it is intended to be used by that person or group or for that purpose.

words.ex: Leaves fall in autumn.
words.en: Autumn is the season between summer and winter when leaves change color and the weather becomes cooler.

words.tr: v. 抓住；赶上；“catch”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The boy caught a fish in the river.
words.ex_cn: 男孩在河里抓到了一条鱼。
words.en: Caught is the past tense and past participle of catch, which means to seize or capture something or someone.

words.ex: He is the author of this book.
words.en: An author is a person who writes books, stories, or articles, especially as a job.

words.ex: I have four apples.
words.en: The number equivalent to the sum of three and one; one more than three.

words.ex: The case will be heard in court next week.
words.ex_cn: 这个案件将于下周在法院审理。
words.en: A court is a place where legal matters are decided by a judge and jury or by a magistrate.

words.ex: He has fourteen apples in his basket.
words.ex_cn: 他的篮子里有十四个苹果。
words.en: The number 14.

words.tr:
adj. 温暖的；

words.ex: The sun gives us warm light.
words.en: Having or giving out a moderate degree of heat, as perceived by the senses.

words.tr: n. 四分之一；季度；一刻钟；地区；方向；

words.ex_cn: 他吃了四分之一的比萨。
words.en: A quarter is one of four equal parts of something, or a period of three months.

words.en: A war is a period of fighting or conflict between countries or states.

words.ex: I draw money from the bank every week.

words.ex: I saw a bird fly over the house.
words.ex_cn: 我看到一只鸟飞过房子。

The cut is made by placing the toothed edge against the material and moving it forcefully forth and less forcefully back or continuously forward.

words.ex: He eats a strawberry every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上吃一颗草莓。
words.en: A strawberry is a small red fruit which is soft and juicy and has tiny yellow seeds on its surface.

words.ex: He broke the law and was arrested.
words.ex_cn: 他违反了法律，被逮捕了。
words.en: A law is a rule or set of rules for good behaviour which is considered right and important by the majority of people for moral, religious, or emotional reasons.

words.tr:
n. 板；董事会；
v. 上船（或火车、飞机等）；
words.ex: He nailed the picture to the board.
words.en: A board is a flat, thin, rectangular piece of wood or other material used for a particular purpose, such as cutting food on or as a surface for writing or playing games. It can also refer to a group of people who manage or control a company or organization, or to the meals provided by an institution such as a school or hospital. As a verb, it means to get onto a ship, aircraft, or other vehicle, or to provide meals and lodging for someone.

words.ex: The girl is playing with her dog.
words.ex_cn: 这个女孩正在和她的狗玩。
words.en: A girl is a female child or young woman.

words.ex: He wears a white shirt to work.
words.ex_cn: 他穿一件白衬衫去上班。
words.en: A shirt is a piece of clothing for the upper body, typically having a collar, sleeves, and buttons down the front.

words.ex: She wore a red skirt to the party.
words.ex_cn: 她穿了一条红色短裙去参加派对。
words.en: A skirt is a piece of clothing that hangs from the waist and covers part or all of the legs. It can also refer to the edge or border of something, or to the act of moving along the edge of something.

words.ex: He has thirty books in his bag.
words.en: The number 30.

words.ex: The nurse gave the patient medicine.
words.en: A nurse is a person whose job is to care for people who are ill or injured, especially in a hospital.

words.ex: The turtle walks slowly on the sand.
words.en: A turtle is a reptile with a hard shell that lives in the sea or on land.

words.ex: I have a meeting on Thursday.
words.en: Thursday is the day of the week between Wednesday and Friday.

words.ex: He eats a burger for lunch.
words.en: A burger is a flat round mass of minced meat or vegetables, which is fried and often eaten in a bread roll.

words.ex: I learn English every day.
words.en: To gain knowledge or skill by studying, practicing, being taught, or experiencing something.

words.ex: The earth goes around the sun.
words.en: The planet on which we live; the land surface of the world as distinct from the sea or the air.

words.tr:
adj. 早的；早前的；
adv. 提早地；
words.ex: He woke up early this morning.
words.en: Before the usual or expected time; at or near the beginning of a particular period or series of events.

words.ex: He works hard to earn money.
words.ex_cn: 他努力工作以赚取收入。
words.en: To earn means to gain something, especially money or respect, through your own efforts or work.

words.ex: This is her book.
words.en: Used as the object of a verb or preposition to refer to a female person or animal previously mentioned or easily identified.

words.ex: A kind person helped me find my way.
words.ex_cn: 一位善良的人帮我找到了路。
words.en: A human being regarded as an individual.

words.tr: v. 效劳；服务；为……工作；招待；
words.ex: He serves the community as a volunteer.
words.ex_cn: 他作为志愿者为社区效劳。
words.en: To perform duties or services for (a person or an organization).

words.tr:
n. 术语；学期；期限；措辞；
v. 把…称作；把…叫做；
words.ex: The word 'algorithm' is a technical term in computer science.
words.ex_cn: ‘算法’是计算机科学中的一个术语。
words.en: A term is a word or expression used in relation to a particular subject, especially one that has a specific meaning, or a fixed period of time during which something lasts or is intended to happen.

words.tr:
n. 工作；活计；作品；制作品；
v. （使）工作；（使）运转；操作；经营；起作用；
words.ex: He finds his work very meaningful.
words.ex_cn: 他觉得他的工作很有意义。
words.en: Work is an activity in which you use effort in order to do a task or achieve a result.

words.tr:
n. 词；单词；话语；
v. 用词语表达；
words.ex: This word means 'happy' in English.
words.ex_cn: 这个词在英语中意思是‘高兴’。
words.en: A single unit of language that has meaning and can be spoken or written.

words.ex: He loves the world and wants to travel everywhere.
words.ex_cn: 他热爱这个世界，想要去所有地方旅行。
words.en: The earth, together with all of its countries, peoples, and natural features.

words.ex: The bird ate a worm.
words.en: A worm is a small, long, thin creature with no bones or legs that lives in soil.

words.ex: I see a bird in the tree.
words.en: to perceive with the eyes; to understand or comprehend something

words.ex: I have three apples.
words.en: The number equivalent to the sum of one and two; one more than two.

words.tr:
adj. 绿色的；未熟的；无经验的；
n. 绿色；

words.en: Green is the color between blue and yellow in the spectrum. It is the color of growing grass and leaves.

words.ex: The sheep graze quietly in the field.
words.ex_cn: 绵羊在田野里安静地吃草。
words.en: A sheep is a farm animal which is covered with thick curly hair called wool. Sheep are kept for their wool or for their meat.

words.ex: He eats an apple every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上吃一个苹果。
words.en: To consume food, typically as a regular part of one's diet.

words.ex: He drinks tea every morning.
words.en: Tea is a drink made by pouring boiling water onto the dried leaves of the tea bush. It is popular in many countries and is often served hot with milk and sugar.

words.ex: He eats meat every day.
words.en: Meat is the flesh of an animal that is eaten as food.

words.ex: The teacher helps students with math.
words.ex_cn: 老师帮助学生学习数学。
words.en: A teacher is a person whose job is to teach in a school or college.

words.ex: He is my brother.
words.en: used to refer to a man, boy, or male animal previously mentioned or easily identified

words.ex: He gave the book to me.
words.en: Me is the object pronoun used to refer to oneself as the object of a verb or preposition.

words.ex: She is reading a book.
words.en: used to refer to a woman, girl, or female animal previously mentioned or easily identified.

words.ex: We are eating lunch now.
words.en: We is the first person plural pronoun used by a speaker or writer to refer to themselves and one or more other people considered together.

words.tr:
n. 件；作品；片；块；
v. 拼凑；
words.ex: She bought a piece of cake.
words.en: A piece of something is an amount of it that has been broken off, torn off, or cut off.

words.tr:
adj. 关键的；
n. 钥匙；关键；
words.ex: This is a key step to solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 这是解决问题的关键步骤。
words.en: A key is a specially shaped piece of metal that you place in a lock and turn in order to open or lock a door, or to start or stop the engine of a vehicle.

words.ex: He likes to ski in the mountains during winter.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在冬天去山里滑雪。
words.en: A ski is one of a pair of long, flat runners attached to the feet for gliding over snow. Skiing is the activity of gliding over snow on skis.

words.tr: n. 比萨饼；披萨；意大利薄饼；
words.ex: I ate a pizza for dinner.
words.ex_cn: 我晚餐吃了一块比萨饼。
words.en: A pizza is a flat, round piece of dough baked with tomato, cheese, and sometimes other ingredients on top.

words.ex: He bought two kilos of apples.
words.en: A kilo is a unit of measurement equal to 1,000 grams or approximately 2.2 pounds. It is commonly used to measure weight.

words.tr:
n. 警方；警察部门；
v. 监督；
words.ex: The police caught the thief last night.
words.en: The police are the official organization that is responsible for making sure that people obey the law, for catching criminals, and for keeping public order.

words.ex: There are 38 people in the classroom.
words.en: People are men, women, and children. People is often used to refer to a large group of people, especially when their exact number is not known or not important.

words.ex: He eats healthy food every day.
words.en: Food is what people and animals eat to live and grow.

words.ex: He ate a bowl of noodles for dinner.
words.en: Noodles are long, thin pieces of food made from a mixture of flour, water, and sometimes egg, which are cooked in boiling water.

words.ex: The room has a bed and a window.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间有一张床和一扇窗户。
words.en: A room is a part of the inside of a building that is separated from other parts by walls, floor, and ceiling.

words.ex: He brushed his tooth after breakfast.
words.en: One of the hard, white objects in the mouth that are used for biting and chewing.

words.ex: I do my homework every evening.
words.en: To perform or accomplish something

words.ex: Who is that girl?
words.en: You use who in questions to ask about the name, identity, or function of one or more people.

words.ex: The boy whose bag is red is my brother.
words.ex_cn: 那个书包是红色的男孩是我弟弟。
words.en: You use whose to ask about the person that something belongs to or is associated with.

words.tr:
v. 移动；搬家；
n. 行动；移动；
words.ex: Please move the chair.
words.en: To change position or to cause something or someone to change position, especially in a particular direction or to a particular place.

words.ex: The ruler made laws for his people.
words.ex_cn: 这位统治者为他的人民制定法律。
words.en: A ruler is a person who governs or commands. It can also refer to a straight strip or cylinder of plastic, wood, metal, or other rigid material, typically marked at regular intervals and used to draw straight lines or measure distances.

words.ex: We will go to the beach in June.
words.en: the sixth month of the year, in the northern hemisphere usually considered the first month of summer

words.ex: The truth is that he was late for work.
words.en: The truth is the true facts about something, rather than what is imagined or invented.

words.ex: He is eating soup for lunch.
words.en: Soup is a liquid food made by boiling meat, fish, or vegetables in water or stock.

words.tr:
n. 组；群；集团；

words.ex_cn: 这些学生组成一个五人小组。
words.en: A group is a number of people or things that are located, gathered, or classed together.

words.ex: The balloon went up into the sky.

words.ex: Playing games with friends is fun.
words.ex_cn: 和朋友一起玩游戏很有趣。
words.en: If you say that someone is fun or that they are fun to be with, you mean that you enjoy being with them because they make you feel happy and amused.

words.ex: I eat lunch at noon every day.
words.en: A meal eaten in the middle of the day, typically one that is lighter or less formal than an evening meal.

words.ex: He drank water from a cup.
words.en: A cup is a small round container that you drink from. Cups usually have handles and are made from china or plastic.

words.ex: Please come to my house tomorrow.
words.en: To move or travel towards the speaker or with the speaker; to arrive at a place; to happen or take place.

words.tr:
v. 热爱；爱；
n. 爱；爱情；爱好的事物；
words.ex: I love playing football with my friends.
words.ex_cn: 我热爱和朋友们一起踢足球。
words.en: Love is a very strong feeling of affection towards someone that you are romantically or sexually attracted to.

words.ex: My mother cooks dinner every evening.
words.ex_cn: 我妈妈每天晚上做晚饭。
words.en: A mother is a female parent of a child. Mothers are women who inhabit or perform the role of bearing some relation to their children, who may or may not be their biological offspring.

words.ex: My brother plays soccer every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 我哥哥每个周末都踢足球。
words.en: A brother is a man or boy in relation to other sons and daughters of his parents.

words.tr:
n. 麻烦；问题；困难；
v. 费神；
words.ex: He got into trouble for breaking the rules.
words.ex_cn: 他因为违反规则而惹上了麻烦。
words.en: If you say that someone is in trouble, you mean that they are in a situation that is difficult to deal with and that may cause them problems.

words.ex: The wood surface is rough.
words.en: If a surface is rough, it is not smooth and has bumps or uneven areas.

words.tr:
n. 两倍；
v. 加倍；是…的两倍；把…对折；
words.ex: He earned a double of his salary last month.
words.ex_cn: 他上个月赚了两倍的薪水。
words.en: If something is double, it is twice as much or twice as many. If you double something, you make it twice as much or twice as many.

words.tr:
adv. 足够地；充分地；
adj. 足够的；充足的；
int. 够了；
words.ex: He didn't run fast enough to win the race.
words.ex_cn: 他跑得不够快，没能赢得比赛。

words.ex_cn: 他在事故后失了很多血。

words.tr:
n. 洪水；水灾；
v. 淹没；泛滥；

words.ex_cn: 大雨导致了村庄发生洪水。
words.en: A flood is an overflow of water that submerges land which is usually dry. In the sense of 'flowing water', the word may also be applied to the inflow of the tide.

words.ex: He put the books in a box.
words.ex_cn: 他把书放进了一个箱子里。
words.en: A box is a container with a flat base and sides, typically square or rectangular and having a lid.

words.ex: The fox ran quickly through the forest.
words.en: A fox is a wild animal which looks like a dog and has reddish-brown fur, a pointed face and ears, and a thick tail. Foxes are often described as cunning and sly.

words.ex: The soup is hot.
words.en: Having a high degree of heat or a high temperature.

words.ex: He is not happy.
words.en: Used to make a negative statement or to negate a verb, adjective, or other adverb.

words.ex: I wash my hands before eating.
words.en: To clean something using water and usually soap.

words.ex: I want a cup of tea.
words.en: If you want something, you feel a desire or a need for it.

words.tr:
v. 观看；观察；小心；

words.ex_cn: 她去年搬到了澳大利亚。
words.en: A country comprising the mainland of the Australian continent, the island of Tasmania, and numerous smaller islands.

words.tr: n. 知识；了解；学问；学识；
words.ex: He gained knowledge from reading books.
words.ex_cn: 他通过读书获得了知识。
words.en: Knowledge is information and understanding about a subject which a person has, or which all people have.

words.tr:
prep. 关于；大约；大概；涉及；

words.ex: She bought a beautiful china cup at the market.
words.ex_cn: 她在市场上买了一个漂亮的瓷杯。

words.ex: He eats a banana every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上吃一根香蕉。
words.en: A banana is a long curved fruit with a yellow skin and soft, sweet, white flesh inside.

words.tr:
adv. 在今天；当今；
n. 今天；当今；
words.ex: I will finish my homework today.
words.ex_cn: 我今天会完成我的作业。
words.en: This day, as distinct from yesterday or tomorrow.

words.tr:
n. 明天；
adv. 在明天；

words.en: The day after today; in the future.

words.ex: We work together every day.

words.en: If you collect a number of things, you gather them together, usually because you want them for a particular purpose.

words.ex: The teacher helps students with math.
words.ex_cn: 老师帮助学生学习数学。
words.en: A teacher is a person whose job is to teach in a school or college.

words.ex: My mother cooks dinner every evening.
words.ex_cn: 我妈妈每天晚上做晚饭。
words.en: A mother is a female parent of a child. Mothers are women who inhabit or perform the role of bearing some relation to their children, who may or may not be their biological offspring.

If a secret is out, it is known by people who were not supposed to know it. words.en: A chair is a piece of furniture for one person to sit on, with a back and usually four legs.

words.ex: The air is clean after the rain.
words.en: Air is the invisible gaseous substance surrounding the earth, a mixture mainly of oxygen and nitrogen.

words.tr:
adj. 公平的；相当大的；合理的；
n. 集市；
words.ex: The teacher gave a fair grade to every student.
words.ex_cn: 老师给每个学生都给了一个公平的分数。
words.en: Fair means treating people equally without favouritism or discrimination.

words.tr:
n. 照料；谨慎；关心；
v. 关心；在意；在乎；
words.ex: The nurse gave the baby good care.
words.ex_cn: 护士给了婴儿很好的照料。
words.en: If you care about something, you feel that it is important and are concerned about it.

words.tr:
v. 共享；分享；
n. 分享；股份；
words.ex: They share their food with friends.
words.en: If you share something with another person, you both have it, use it, or are involved in it. You can also say that two people share something.

words.ex: The loud noise scared the child.
words.ex_cn: 巨大的噪音吓到了孩子。
words.en: If something scares you, it frightens or worries you.

words.tr:
n. 平方；广场；正方形；四方形；
adj. 正方形的；四方形的；平方的；成直角的；
v. 与...一致；
adv. 成直角地；
words.ex: The area of the room is 16 square.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间的面积是16平方米。
words.en: A square is a shape with four sides of equal length and four angles of 90 degrees. It can also refer to an open area in a town, often used for public events, or to the result of multiplying a number by itself.

words.ex: There is a book on the table.
words.en: Used to indicate the place where someone or something is or where something happens.

words.ex: Where is the book?
words.en: You use where to ask questions about the place or position of someone or something, or to indicate the place or position of someone or something.

words.tr: n. 旅游；游览；巡回活动；
words.ex: We went on a tour of Paris last summer.
words.ex_cn: 去年夏天我们去巴黎旅游了。
words.en: A tour is a journey in which you visit several places that interest you, especially on holiday.

words.ex: He painted a gourd for the festival.
words.ex_cn: 他为节日画了一个葫芦。
words.en: A gourd is a large fruit with a hard skin, often used for decoration or as a container.

words.tr: adj. 拙劣的；贫穷的；缺少的；可怜的；
words.ex: The acting in that movie was poor.
words.ex_cn: 那部电影的表演很拙劣。
words.en: If you describe someone as poor, you mean that they do not have enough money to live on or that they have very little money.

words.tr: n. 粗野的人；无教养的人；乡下佬
words.ex: The boor shouted loudly in the library.
words.ex_cn: 那个粗鲁的人在图书馆里大声喊叫。
words.en: A boor is a rude, insensitive, or ill-mannered person.

words.tr:
adj. 确信；必定的；
adv. 当然；当然可以；
words.ex: I am sure he will come tomorrow.
words.en: If you are sure that something is true, you are certain that it is true. If you say that something is sure to happen, you mean that it will definitely happen.

words.ex: He insured his car against accidents.
words.ex_cn: 他为自己的车投保了意外险。
words.en: If you insure yourself or your property, you pay money to an insurance company so that if you become ill or if your property is damaged or stolen, the company will pay you a sum of money.

words.ex: I assure you that everything will be fine.
words.ex_cn: 我向你保证一切都会好起来的。
words.en: If you assure someone that something is true or will happen, you tell them that it is definitely true or will definitely happen, often in order to make them less worried.
